author: root

silhouette.reason: Readable compact human, but the broad red crown still dominates the body and resembles a mushroom helmet. Torso/shoulder shape is serviceable rather than a distinctive, balanced hero design.

anatomy.reason: Wider shoulders, retained jaw width and longer2px legs now yield a coherent small person. Profile face is a nearly vertical skin wall without a convincing nose/forehead separation, and swinging profile sleeve/hand clusters still interleave visually with bag/waist.

walking.reason: Genuine support/swing exchange and longer legs now read as walking in all directions. Profile idle shoes still join into a4px brown bar at native y29; only bottom-row soles are separated. Step shoes become separate2px blocks, so foot silhouette changes abruptly rather than rolling through a consistent shoe shape.

pixelCraft.reason: Connected large clusters are clean enough for serviceable native art. Crown highlight pixels, similar dark blue shades and abrupt sleeve/hand intersections still provide weak volume. The thin dark profile brim looks like a spike, while front brim remains an undifferentiated full-width rim.

identity.reason: Cap/vest/gold-red pack remain consistent across directions, with a real gold/red bag profile. Cap brim and hair silhouette are not yet shaped clearly enough to create a polished hero identity; back pack is a flat color plaque with little attachment/depth.

directionContinuity.reason: All directions retain the same costume, color placements and proportions; heading is clear. Flat nose-less side face and compressed accessories limit believable turn depth.

loop.reason: Four140ms frames, repeated identical idle at1/3 and coherent1px step bob produce a repeatable cycle without a file-level seam. Shoe silhouette/contact transitions remain visibly abrupt.

requiredCorrections: Redesign cap as crown plus directional brim: remove uninterrupted mushroom-like front rim, replace profile dark spike with a coherent brim, simplify highlight cluster and clarify hair/cap separation.
Shape profile forehead/nose/chin so eye and facing direction belong to a face rather than a flat rectangular skin edge. Preserve the improved jaw/neck continuity.

Use one stable shoe design across poses; separate the profile idle shoes throughout their visible clusters, not only on y30. Keep support/swing differentiation without switching from a continuous brown bar to two unrelated blocks.
Clean profile cream sleeve/skin/waist intersections and give back pack a clear attachment/edge with selective depth. Retain improved torso/leg proportions and profile gold-red bag.
failureReason: Total73 is below the immutable85 minimum. All axis minima are met; no critical failure is invented to justify rejection.
